employers.description: AHMC Seton Medical Center is an acute-care hospital in Daly City serving San Francisco and northern San Mateo County, with roots going back to its founding as Mary's Help Hospital in 1893. The facility operates a 24/7 emergency department alongside specialty programs in cancer care, cardiac care (including STEMI response), stroke care, and geriatric behavioral health, plus a skilled nursing facility at its Coastside campus in Moss Beach. It is part of AHMC Healthcare Inc. and employs clinical, diagnostic, and allied health staff across both campuses.
employers.name: AHMC Seton Medical Center

employers.description: Seton Medical Center Coastside is a community hospital located at 600 Marine Blvd in Moss Beach, CA, operating under AHMC Healthcare. The facility has been closed since at least April 2024; its emergency department closure prompted a lawsuit by the California Attorney General alleging breach of the contractual obligation AHMC accepted when it acquired the hospital in 2020. As of mid-2026 no reopening has been announced and the official site carries a "temporarily closed" notice.

employers.description: Kaiser Permanente operates the Redwood City Medical Center, a 149-bed acute-care hospital at 1100 Veterans Blvd serving the San Mateo County area, offering inpatient and outpatient care across specialties including emergency medicine, surgery, cardiology, labor and delivery, neuroscience ICU, and interventional radiology. As part of Kaiser Permanente's integrated delivery model, the facility combines hospital care with a health plan and physician group under one system, coordinating primary care, specialty medicine, and pharmacy on a single campus. Clinical, nursing, pharmacy, imaging, and administrative staff roles are all located at this site.

employers.description: The Menlo Park campus of the VA Palo Alto Health Care System specializes in behavioral health and residential rehabilitation for veterans, offering PTSD treatment programs, substance use recovery (outpatient and 24-hour residential), mental health crisis services, and physical and occupational therapy. The campus also runs Compensated Work Therapy — a vocational rehabilitation program — along with audiology, sleep medicine, dental care, and Whole Health integrative services. Clinical staff include licensed therapists, psychologists, speech-language pathologists, registered dietitians, and social workers serving veterans across the greater Bay Area.

employers.description: Mills-Peninsula Medical Center is a 241-bed, not-for-profit acute-care hospital in Burlingame, CA, operated by Sutter Health. The 450,000-square-foot campus offers 24/7 emergency and ICU services alongside inpatient and outpatient programs in cardiology, neurology, oncology, orthopedics, labor and delivery, surgery, and rehabilitation. It employs clinical staff across nursing, allied health, and medical specialties serving the San Francisco Peninsula.

employers.description: San Mateo Medical Center is a county-operated acute care and ambulatory health system serving all residents of San Mateo County, including a substantial safety-net population. It provides 24/7 emergency care, primary and specialty care, integrated behavioral health, dental, rehabilitation, and skilled nursing services across five sites in Daly City, Half Moon Bay, Redwood City, San Mateo, and South San Francisco. The system employs physicians, nurses, allied health professionals, and behavioral health staff county-wide, making it one of the largest public healthcare employers on the San Mateo peninsula.

employers.description: Vituity (legally CEP America, LLC) is a 100% physician-owned multispecialty partnership founded over fifty years ago in California that now staffs and manages more than 900 practice locations across the U.S., treating roughly 14.5 million patients annually. Core service lines include emergency medicine, hospital medicine, critical care, and telehealth, alongside newer specialties such as psychiatry, radiology, anesthesiology, and neurology. The organization employs over 9,000 clinicians — physicians, advanced practice providers, and non-clinical operations staff — making it a significant regional employer of emergency and acute-care talent in California.
